translated: Also, I often do this when I'm reading, but I'll play Western music or BGM that fits the story.
The other day, I was reading a book set in the Mayan civilization...
You really read all sorts of books, don't you?
At the time, I searched for free music that sounded like the Mayan civilization, and some actually came up.
Listening to that really gets Shizuku in the mood.
If it's an action story, I'll pick something intense...
And if it's set by the sea, I'll listen to sounds of the ocean.
I listen to ambient sounds like that.
Do you have specific books you like to bring on trips?
Oh, when I travel, I try to bring books I've already started. I usually have a few different ones going at the same time.
My mood changes, so I might feel like reading one thing one day and something else the next.
Since the genres are all different, I really want to narrow them down when I travel, you know?
Because I want to pack light.
But if I start reading and realize I'm not in the mood for that specific book, I really regret it.
